description: Your study and research notebook inside your AI: build a base on this computer from YouTube, documents and 70 public sources, ask with citations to the minute or the page, and study with flashcards, quizzes and mind maps that stay saved.
long_description:
Tusab turns Claude (or another MCP-compatible AI) into a study and research notebook connected to **your** sources, kept on this computer.

**Build your base**
- **YouTube:** transcripts of channels, playlists and videos, extracted on this computer, from your own IP, with automatic channel updates.
- **Documents:** PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, TXT/Markdown, web pages and FHIR, with the original file kept.
- **70 public sources** in 11 areas: arXiv, PubMed, SciELO, Brazilian Chamber and Senate, Supreme Court, IBGE, Central Bank, open data portals and others, with no sign-up or key.

**Ask with citations**
- The AI fetches only the right excerpts and cites the source: the video and the minute, with a link, or the PDF page.
- It uses fewer tokens than attaching whole sources, and Tusab shows how much it saved.

**Study, teach and create**
- **Library with 41 ready-made prompts**, 20 of them based on evidence-based techniques (pretest, interleaved practice, backward design, PRISMA, pre-mortem…), to study, teach, research and decide, with the suggested AI model for each task.
- **What the AI creates stays saved in Tusab:** flashcards with spaced repetition, summaries, quizzes, mind maps and lesson plans, which open drawn in the Materials tab.

**On the Tusab screen** (in the browser, served by this computer): extraction, repository, materials and export or import of the base (.tusab, zip, spreadsheet and PDF). In Portuguese, English and Spanish.

**Privacy:** the base stays on this computer. Nothing goes through CriAugu servers; only the excerpts the AI queries go to the AI you chose.

tools.name: tusab_buscar
tools.description: Searches the local base and returns excerpts with source, minute and link.

tools.name: tusab_listar_projetos
tools.description: Lists the projects, with sources, excerpts and extraction coverage.

tools.name: tusab_ler_fonte
tools.description: Reads a source in order, starting from a given minute.

tools.name: tusab_ler_original
tools.description: Opens the original file of a document (an image, or pages of a PDF) when the text is not enough.

tools.name: tusab_adicionar_youtube
tools.description: Extracts a channel, playlist or video on this computer and indexes it.

tools.name: tusab_adicionar_arquivo
tools.description: Adds a .txt or .md file to the project texts.

tools.name: tusab_fontes_publicas
tools.description: Lists the 70 public sources (arXiv, PubMed, Brazilian Chamber of Deputies, IBGE...) by area.

tools.name: tusab_buscar_fonte_publica
tools.description: Searches a public source for a topic and saves the results in the project.

tools.name: tusab_salvar_estudo
tools.description: Saves flashcards, sticky notes or a summary created by the AI, to review in other conversations.

tools.name: tusab_revisao_hoje
tools.description: Lists the flashcards due today (spaced repetition).

tools.name: tusab_registrar_revisao
tools.description: Records the grade of a reviewed flashcard.

tools.name: tusab_novidades_semana
tools.description: Lists what was added to the project in the last 7 days.

tools.name: tusab_economia
tools.description: Shows how many tokens Tusab saved the AI (excerpts only × whole sources). Local estimate.

tools.name: tusab_status
tools.description: Shows the repository, the running extraction and the queue.

tools.name: tusab_abrir_painel
tools.description: Opens the Tusab screen in the browser, served by this computer.

prompts.name: abrir_tusab
prompts.description: Opens the Tusab screen in the browser.

prompts.name: flashcards
prompts.description: Short questions and answers, saved for spaced repetition.

prompts.name: revisar-hoje
prompts.description: The flashcards due today, one at a time, with a grade and rescheduling.

prompts.name: quiz
prompts.description: Questions with 4 options, one at a time, with explained answers.

prompts.name: resumo
prompts.description: Central theme, key concepts, insights and gaps — saved in the project.

prompts.name: mapa-mental
prompts.description: Hierarchical structure of the concepts (Mermaid).

prompts.name: explicar-simples
prompts.description: An explanation for beginners, with examples.

prompts.name: plano-estudo
prompts.description: A day-by-day plan, in the right order of the content.

prompts.name: prova
prompts.description: Objective and open questions, answer key and grading criteria.

prompts.name: plano-aula
prompts.description: Goals, sequence, activities and assessment based on the sources.

prompts.name: exercicios
prompts.description: Basic, intermediate and advanced exercises with solutions.

prompts.name: revisao-literatura
prompts.description: What the sources say, where they agree and where they differ.

prompts.name: contradicoes
prompts.description: Where the sources contradict each other, side by side.

prompts.name: lacunas
prompts.description: What the material lacks to cover the topic well.

prompts.name: ficha-leitura
prompts.description: For each source: thesis, arguments, evidence and quotes.

prompts.name: linha-do-tempo
prompts.description: Events and dates in chronological order.

prompts.name: citacoes
prompts.description: The most important sentences, verbatim and with the source.

prompts.name: resposta-verificavel
prompts.description: Answers only with excerpts from the base and states the confidence level.

prompts.name: nota-tecnica
prompts.description: Context, analysis, recommendation and risks, with sources.

prompts.name: roteiro
prompts.description: A script with a hook, development and wrap-up.

prompts.name: post
prompts.description: A short text with one central idea.

prompts.name: digest
prompts.description: What was added to the project in the last 7 days.

prompts.name: pre-teste
prompts.description: Questions before seeing the content, to prime your memory.

prompts.name: recordar-livre
prompts.description: Write what you remember; the AI compares it with the base and makes cards of what was missing.

prompts.name: autoexplicacao
prompts.description: You explain, the AI checks it against the sources and points out what was missing.
prompts.text: Explain it in my own words — project ${arguments.projeto}

prompts.name: pratica-intercalada
prompts.description: Questions from shuffled subtopics: you learn to recognize which concept to use.

prompts.name: exemplo-resolvido
prompts.description: One explained example, then one with gaps and one without help.

prompts.name: mapa-conceitual
prompts.description: Concepts linked by phrases (causes, depends on…), in Mermaid.

prompts.name: objetivos-bloom
prompts.description: Learning objectives at the 6 levels, with questions for each one.

prompts.name: planejamento-reverso
prompts.description: From the expected result to assessment and lessons, with the excerpts to use.

prompts.name: rubrica
prompts.description: Criteria and performance levels, with a self-assessment version.

prompts.name: checagem-formativa
prompts.description: A few questions to see whether the class understood and what to revisit.

prompts.name: aula-invertida
prompts.description: A list of excerpts to watch before class and an activity for class time.

prompts.name: pergunta-pico
prompts.description: Turns the topic into clear questions and says what the base already answers.

prompts.name: triagem-prisma
prompts.description: Inclusion criteria, reason for each exclusion and counts per stage.

prompts.name: matriz-sintese
prompts.description: A source × theme table and a synthesis by idea, not by source.

prompts.name: analise-tematica
prompts.description: Codes, themes and example excerpts from interviews and meetings.

prompts.name: resumo-executivo
prompts.description: The conclusion first, then the arguments that support it.

prompts.name: pre-mortem
prompts.description: Imagines it went wrong and lists why, with warning signs.

prompts.name: hipoteses-concorrentes
prompts.description: A matrix of evidence for and against each possible explanation.

prompts.name: ideia-memoravel
prompts.description: One idea from the material as a sentence, a paragraph and a 1-minute script.

prompts.name: reflexao-semana
prompts.description: What I learned, what is still unclear and next week's goal.
